guard: A leftover unsettled turn acceptance whose pending latch is gone is aged off leftoverSince, never the original deadline, so a failed deadline commit cannot pin the sweep forever and a long-outage leftover is not pruned on the first tick.

mutations.name: an unsettled leftover ages off the original deadline, not the latch-drop stamp
mutations.expectRed: the sweep drops a stale unsettled acceptance once its retry window has passed
mutations.cell: the sweep drops a stale unsettled acceptance once its retry window has passed, and keeps a fresh one
